thread:
Sofia (partnerships): quick sync: partners are seeing inconsistent error shapes across Partner API endpoints and SDKs. propose a single "partner-error" envelope and explicit retry semantics (idempotency keys + retry-after). Need SDK updates, marketplace connector tests, and partner comms. Thoughts?
Ethan (eng): absolutely. Current reality: some endpoints return {error:{code,msg}} others return top-level "error_code" strings. Breaking for shallow parsers. We can introduce `error.code` (string), `error.reason` (machine tag), `error.human` (message), and `error.retryable` (bool). We'll support both shapes with a compat header for 60 days.
Camila (product): agree on unified shape. Add a non-numeric string `code` (e.g., "quota_exceeded", "model_unavailable"). Product will draft a mapping table and partner FAQ. Recommend partner preview + a compatibility badge in marketplace.
Ibrahim (legal): check contract implications for changing error semantics. Usually not a formal "breaking change" but anything that affects retry behavior for billing or SLA needs review. I'll confirm by next Tue.
Zack (platform): runtime plan: gateway will normalize and emit `X-RW-Error-Spec: v1` header when normalized. We'll also add `Retry-After` when applicable and support idempotency via `Idempotency-Key` header server-side. Canary in eu-west first. Ops runbook RNW-7123 created.
June (devex): I'll own the SDK surface changes: add `.error()` accessor returning {code, reason, human, retryable, retry_after}. Also publish a tiny shim `@redwood/error-envelope` that maps legacy shapes into the new envelope for partners who can't upgrade quickly. ETA for shim alpha: Apr 10.
MarketplaceOpsBot: @Sofia created issue RNW-7123 "Partner error envelope + retry semantics" https://issues.redwood.ai/RNW-7123
Ethan (eng): telemetry: emit `error_envelope_mismatch` when we detect legacy shapes and provide a daily export of partner IDs + endpoints using legacy errors. Also add a dashboard widget for retryable errors rate.
Sofia (partnerships): action items: Partnerships to notify top 18 partners + marketplace vendors Apr 14. Camila to draft mapping guide + FAQ by Apr 7. June to ship shim alpha Apr 10. Zack to enable gateway normalization canary Apr 17. Ibrahim to confirm legal notice timing Apr 5. Ethan to provision telemetry by Apr 9.
Camila (product): draft mapping posted: http://go/redwood/error-envelope-mapping  includes examples, recommended Idempotency-Key patterns, and suggested backoff strategies. Please review.
June (devex): shim example (JS): `app.use(require('@redwood/error-envelope')()); // normalizes legacy error shapes to error:{code,reason,human,retryable}` will also publish pypi package and Docker image for on-prem partners.
Zack (platform): canary plan: eu-west Apr 17, us-west Apr 24, marketplace connector tests Apr 27, global Apr 30. Enforcement: after 60-day runway, gateway will default to normalized envelope and marketplace connectors must pass compat-check or be flagged.
Ibrahim (legal): flagged two enterprise partners with custom retry SLAs; partnerships to do targeted outreach and coordinate legal notices.
Ethan (eng): will add a lightweight validation endpoint partners can hit to confirm they receive the normalized error envelope: `/partner/v1/compat/error-check`. Also will add CI tests that run against marketplace connectors during preview.
Sofia (partnerships): owners confirmed: partnerships=Sofia, eng=Ethan, devex=June, platform=Zack, product=Camila, legal=Ibrahim. Everyone please update RNW-7123 with owner + ETA and tag me.
June (devex): scheduling a partner webinar Apr 12 to walk through the error shapes and retry examples. Will publish short demo video.
Camila (product): proposed comms timeline: Apr 5 mapping + FAQ, Apr 10 shim alpha + partner preview, Apr 12 webinar, Apr 17 gateway canary, Apr 30 public docs + marketplace badge, June 1 enforcement (legacy shapes still accepted during 60-day grace then flagged).
Sofia (partnerships): thanks team, partnerships will prep outreach templates and an escalation matrix for the top SIs and marketplace vendors. :thumbsup:
All: :thumbsup:
